selection_criteria.high_activation_frequency: Features with significant presence in musical data (>0.01 activation frequency)
selection_criteria.clear_musical_interpretation: Features with well-understood, interpretable musical meaning from diversity analysis
selection_criteria.diverse_categories: Covering different aspects: rhythmic, dynamic, textural, structural, harmonic
selection_criteria.audible_impact: Features likely to produce perceptible changes in generated music

feature_selection_metadata.selection_methodology: Analyzed enhanced diversity reports for layers 1, 3, 5 to identify features with highest combination of activation frequency, interpretability confidence (85%), and category diversity

layer_1.name: rhythmic_displacement
layer_1.interpretation: Rhythmic displacement with sixteenth note shifts creating syncopation effect across instrumental lines
layer_1.selection_rationale: High activation frequency (18.4%), clear rhythmic interpretation, easily audible syncopation effects

layer_1.name: dynamic_contrasts
layer_1.interpretation: Sudden accents followed by soft dynamics creating dramatic ebb and flow within musical texture
layer_1.selection_rationale: Clear dynamic interpretation with high activation strength, easily perceptible volume changes

layer_1.name: wide_pitch_range
layer_1.interpretation: Wide pitch range utilization across multiple instruments emphasizing broad harmonic spectrum and textural depth
layer_1.selection_rationale: Good activation frequency (8.8%), textural category diversity, clear pitch range effects

layer_3.name: antiphonal_texture
layer_3.interpretation: Call-and-response interaction between instrumental groups with contrasting dynamics or articulation
layer_3.selection_rationale: Highest activation frequency (20.5%), very clear call-and-response interpretation, highly audible textural effect

layer_3.name: dynamic_contrasts
layer_3.interpretation: Sudden shifts between high and low velocity ranges within short musical passages creating dramatic tension and release
layer_3.selection_rationale: High activation strength despite lower frequency, clear dynamic interpretation, complements layer 1 dynamic feature

layer_3.name: steady_pulse
layer_3.interpretation: Steady pulse patterns with metronomic consistency and march-like rhythms reinforcing regularity and order
layer_3.selection_rationale: Clear rhythmic interpretation complementing layer 1 rhythmic displacement, steady vs syncopated contrast

layer_5.name: unison_doubling
layer_5.interpretation: Multiple instruments playing same melodic line in octaves creating reinforced and powerful sound
layer_5.selection_rationale: Clear textural interpretation, easily audible unison/octave effects, good activation frequency

layer_5.name: dynamic_contrasts_layer5
layer_5.interpretation: Abrupt shifts between soft and loud dynamics creating dramatic and expressive effect within musical texture
layer_5.selection_rationale: Completes dynamic feature across all layers, clear interpretation, easily audible volume changes

layer_5.name: rhythmic_augmentation
layer_5.interpretation: Systematic lengthening of motifs creating sense of expansion and tension over time
layer_5.selection_rationale: Good activation frequency (5.7%), clear rhythmic interpretation, complements other layer rhythmic features

rationale.conditioning_length: Short conditioning (2 tokens) for immediate intervention impact
rationale.strengths_range: Covers negative (ablation-like), neutral (baseline), and positive (enhancement) intervention effects
rationale.low_temperature: Reduces randomness for clearer intervention signal
rationale.moderate_noise: Adds variability while preserving intervention effects
rationale.auto_seeds: Different seeds per feature ensure diverse musical content while maintaining reproducibility within each feature experiment

layer_1_features.rhythmic_displacement: Should produce syncopated rhythms, off-beat accents, rhythmic complexity variations
layer_1_features.dynamic_contrasts: Should create sudden volume changes, accent patterns, dynamic expression variations
layer_1_features.wide_pitch_range: Should affect pitch span, register usage, melodic range variations

layer_3_features.antiphonal_texture: Should create call-and-response patterns, instrumental dialogue, spatial effects
layer_3_features.dynamic_contrasts: Should produce dramatic volume shifts, expressive dynamics, tension-release patterns
layer_3_features.steady_pulse: Should affect rhythmic regularity, tempo stability, march-like vs fluid rhythm

layer_5_features.unison_doubling: Should create octave doubling, unison passages, instrumental reinforcement
layer_5_features.dynamic_contrasts_layer5: Should produce expressive volume changes, dramatic dynamic effects
layer_5_features.rhythmic_augmentation: Should affect note lengths, temporal expansion, rhythmic density changes

evaluation_plan.perceptual_evaluation: Manual listening to generated WAV files to assess intervention audibility and musical quality
evaluation_plan.quantitative_metrics: MusPy metrics (pitch_class_entropy, scale_consistency, groove_consistency) to assess musical coherence
evaluation_plan.feature_specific_analysis: Targeted measurements for each feature type (rhythm, dynamics, texture, pitch)
evaluation_plan.comparative_analysis: Baseline vs intervention comparisons across all strength levels
